compare.metaTitle: Birthday wall vs e-card vs money pot — which to choose? · hbdwall
compare.metaDesc: Online birthday wall, e-card or group money pot: a clear comparison for wishing a group birthday. Cost, messages, photos, lasting keepsake.
compare.h1: Online birthday wall, e-card or group money pot?
compare.intro: To wish someone a happy birthday as a group, three options keep coming up: the online birthday wall, the e-card, and the money pot. They don’t serve quite the same purpose. Here’s what sets them apart, and which one keeps a real keepsake.
compare.s1Body: A collaborative page where each person leaves a message and a photo. Everything shows up in one place, with no account, and they discover the wall on the day. It’s the option that creates the most emotion, and the only keepsake you reopen years later. Ideal when the thought matters more than the money.
compare.s2Body: A digital card you send, sometimes signed by a few people. Handy and formal, but the message stays short, rarely comes with photos, and gets lost soon after the birthday. Good for a quick note, less so for a real moment.
compare.s3Body: A shared pot to fund a gift. Perfect when the goal is to buy something specific together, but there are often withdrawal fees, and it leaves no emotional trace. Best paired with a wall to add words to the money.
compare.verdictBody: If you want to mark the birthday and keep something that lasts, the online birthday wall is the best choice — free and no account. If the goal is a money gift, use a pot and add a wall for the messages. The e-card is more of a quick fix.

faqSection.title: The online birthday wall, in short

whatIs.title: What is an online birthday wall?
whatIs.p1: An online birthday wall is a collaborative page created for someone: you share the link, and each of their friends leaves a message and a photo. Everything shows up in one place, with no account needed.
whatIs.p2: It’s the perfect group birthday surprise, even from afar: on the day, they discover all the messages together, and you keep the memory collage to print or share.

home.title: Online Birthday Wall · Create yours free | hbdwall
home.description: Create an online birthday wall: your people leave a message and a photo, you keep the memory collage. A group surprise, even from afar. No account, in 30 seconds.

faq.a: hbdwall is a free online birthday wall. You create a page, your people leave a message and a photo, and you keep it all as a memory collage.
Yes. Creating a birthday wall and collecting messages from your people is completely free.

faq.q: Do guests need an account to leave a message?
faq.a: No. Your people leave their note and photo in seconds, without creating an account.
Three steps: create your wall, share the link, your people write. You then get a memory collage to print or share.

faq.q: Can it be used remotely or as a group?
faq.a: Yes. The link can be shared anywhere, making it a perfect group birthday surprise, even from a distance.

faq.q: What happens to the wall after the birthday?
faq.a: It stays accessible. Each year keeps its own wall, like a memory capsule you can reopen years later.
